label: History
value: Matthew desired to keep Anne silently.
unit: Matthew Cuthbert lived a quiet, introverted life at Green Gables alongside his sister Marilla. Due to advancing age and heart trouble, he and Marilla decided to adopt an orphan boy from Nova Scotia to assist with farm work. When Matthew drove to Bright River station, he discovered that a little girl named Anne Shirley had been sent by mistake instead. Reluctant to leave her at the station, he brought her home, falling under her charming personality along the drive and silently desiring to keep her. Matthew continually advocated for keeping Anne and indulged her far more than Marilla did, secretly buying her a puff-sleeved dress for Christmas with the assistance of Mrs. Rachel Lynde. Throughout her schooling, Matthew took immense pride in Anne's academic success and ambitions. Over time, his heart condition worsened while he continued to work hard on the farm. Upon reading a newspaper report announcing the sudden collapse of the Abbey Bank where all his savings were kept, Matthew suffered a fatal heart attack on the threshold of Green Gables and was buried in Avonlea.
